title: Doctor XAvIer: Explainable Diagnosis on Physician-Patient Dialogues and XAI Evaluation
reasoning: The paper mentions the ethical concern of physicians being reluctant to use opaque AI systems for high-risk medical decisions involving patient well-being. However, this is used as motivation for their work on explainable AI (XAI) and is not a central component of evaluation or benchmarking within the paper itself. The core of the paper is a technical contribution, not an ethical analysis.
